fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the execution of the nscurl utility in order to download files.
fields.name: File Download Via Nscurl - MacOS
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/nscurl" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "--download " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "--download-directory " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "--output " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-dir " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-dl " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-ld" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-o ")))
